### Description

As part of the effort to modernize integration tests tracked in #4178, tests that instantiate `test::Relay` mock systems solely to inspect or capture an `EntityComponentManager` pointer can be simplified using the `Server::EcmScope()` API introduced in #4171.

Specifically:
- `test/integration/material.cc`: `MaterialTest::StartServer` instantiates and registers a `test::Relay` system solely to capture `this->ecm`.
- `test/integration/mesh_inertia_calculation.cc`: Three test functions (`cylinderColladaMeshInertiaCalculation`, `cylinderColladaMeshWithNonCenterOriginInertiaCalculation`, and `cylinderColladaOptimizedMeshInertiaCalculation`) instantiate `test::Relay` solely to obtain the ECM pointer (commented as `// Create a system just to get the ECM`).

### Proposed Solution

1. In `test/integration/material.cc`, replace the `test::Relay` mock system with `Server::EcmGuard` acquired via `server->EcmScope()`, and remove `#include "../helpers/Relay.hh"`.
2. In `test/integration/mesh_inertia_calculation.cc`, replace the `test::Relay` boilerplate across all three test functions with `server.EcmScope()`, and remove `#include "../helpers/Relay.hh"`.

### Context
- Sub-task of #4178 ("Refactor tests to use EcmScope")
new_candidates.title: Refactor material and mesh_inertia_calculation integration tests to use EcmScope

### Failing Test
- projectroot.test.test_service_event_publisher__rmw_connextdds

### Log Output
```
[ RUN      ] TestServiceEventPublisherWithServicesAndClientsFixture.test_service_event_publisher_with_subscriber_disable_service_events
W:\src\ros2\rcl\rcl\test\rcl\test_service_event_publisher.cpp(630): error: Value of: wait_for_subscription_to_be_ready(this->subscription_ptr, this->context_ptr, 10, 100)
  Actual: false
Expected: true
```

### Flakyness 15 days
job_name|last_fail|first_fail|build_count|failure_count|failure_percentage
|--|--|--|--|--|--|
nightly_win_rep|2026-11-17|2026-11-02|15|11|73.33

### Initial Investigation
This might be related to a race condition during subscription initialization or DDS endpoint discovery.
Interestingly, the first test `test_service_event_publisher_with_subscriber` passes, while the following test `test_service_event_publisher_with_subscriber_disable_service_events` fails when waiting for the subscription to become ready.
The subscription is expected to be ready, but wait_for_subscription_to_be_ready() returns false.
This appears to be an existing and frequently occurring flaky failure.
Further investigation is needed to determine whether this is related to test synchronization, subscription initialization, or rmw_connextdds behavior on Windows.

This issue could have a common root cause with https://github.com/ros2/rcl/issues/1359, but doesn't seems to be the same issue.
